# Plan B Careers

> Career, job-search and admission guidance from Akola for candidates in Vidarbha and beyond.

Plan B Careers provides guidance and application assistance. Employers and institutions make selection decisions. A listing does not establish an exclusive recruitment partnership or guarantee an outcome.

## Contact and location

- Website: https://planbcareers.in
- Phone: +91 94205 12501
- Email: contact.planbcareers@gmail.com
- Confirmed office: Near City Kotwali, Akola, Maharashtra. Contact the team to arrange a visit and confirm directions.
- Service areas: Akola, Vidarbha, Maharashtra. Service areas do not imply staffed branches.

## Service terms

Service scope and any charges are discussed directly with the team for your situation. Ask for the scope, amount and applicable refund terms in writing before agreeing or paying. Hiring decisions remain with the employer.

## Business track record

The business owner reports 6 years in business and more than 1,000 candidates placed, confirmed on 2026-11-08. These are figures shared by Plan B Careers, not independently audited statistics. They do not guarantee an individual hiring outcome.

## Reading vacancy information accurately

The job directory is the current source of public vacancy information. Closed records and records awaiting essential details are not open for applications. Remote work does not imply worldwide or city-specific eligibility; consult the individual record and confirm eligibility with the hiring team.

Pay is reproduced as advertised. Annual LPA, fixed monthly amounts, in-hand pay, CTC, commissions, incentives and task-based earnings are different measures. An advertised maximum is not a minimum or a guaranteed amount. Do not infer a salary, workplace, employer identity, closing date or employment type when it is absent.

Near City Kotwali, Akola, Maharashtra. Contact the team to arrange a visit and confirm directions. Other city guides and service-area references are not evidence of additional offices.
